column1: Stir the cornstarch into the water until smooth.
In a small saucepan over low heat, combine the cornstarch slurry, brown sugar, honey, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, ginger, and pepper. Bring to a boil, whisking occasionally.
Boil 2 minutes without stirring until syrupy, then remove from heat and let cool at least 10 minutes to thicken.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (204°C) and grease a 2–3 quart baking dish.
Pat the chicken dry, place it in the dish, and scatter the pineapple around it.
Pour the sauce over everything and turn the chicken to coat completely.
Bake uncovered 30–32 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C). Optionally slice the chicken into chunks around the 25-minute mark so it soaks up more sauce.
Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds and serve with the pan sauce spooned over.
